reason: I earn 35 thousand a year and margins are thin, so a monthly fee that is not clearly bringing people through the door gets cut. A three-month minimum for something nobody has used yet is not a risk I take.
objection: I don't have time to manage another platform. I'm behind the bar every night and already do my socials after closing. And I pay 150 euro a month for a thing I can't see filling the bar.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the app already has real people using it in my town, and a pay-per-result deal or a free Venue tier with no minimum, where the founders load everything and I do nothing.
